title: MILimbEEG: Motor and motor-imagery limb EEG dataset (MILimbEEG)
description: MILimbEEG is an EEG dataset of over 8,680 four-second recordings from 60 volunteers performing and imagining upper- and lower-limb movements. Movements include left and right hand closing and dorsal and plantar foot flexion, plus baseline eyes-open and rest conditions. Signals were recorded with a 16-channel dry-electrode OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy system and are intended for motor imagery brain-computer interface research. Participants include healthy volunteers, amputees and post-COVID-19 individuals.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 125 Hz from 16 dry electrodes (10-10 montage) using an OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy with a neutral ear reference. A hardware band-pass of 5-50 Hz and a 60 Hz notch filter were applied. In each repetition, participants executed and then imagined hand closing and foot flexion movements following visual cues, with baseline eyes-open and rest periods.
